# devhelm_monitor_revision (Data Source)

Look up a code monitor revision by `id`, or a monitor's live revision (or revision `number`) by `monitor_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The revision a code monitor runs now.
data "devhelm_monitor_revision" "live" {
  monitor_id = devhelm_monitor.checkout.id
}

# A specific revision by number.
data "devhelm_monitor_revision" "first" {
  monitor_id = devhelm_monitor.checkout.id
  number     = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Revision id
- `monitor_id` (String) Monitor whose live revision (or revision `number`) to read
- `number` (Number) Revision number within the definition; with `monitor_id`, omit for the live revision

### Read-Only

- `authored_by` (String) Who authored the revision
- `created_at` (String) When the revision was created (RFC 3339)
- `created_by_kind` (String) Tool that created the revision: dashboard, git, terraform, api, or mcp
- `definition_id` (String) Definition this revision belongs to
- `digest` (String) Closure digest (sha256:<hex>)
- `entrypoint` (String) File that runs, relative to the bundle root
- `files` (List of String) Files in the revision
- `keys` (List of String) Secret keys the code reads
- `source_branch` (String) Branch that produced this code
- `source_commit` (String) Commit that produced this code
- `source_file` (String) Declaring file in that repository
- `source_repo` (String) Repository that produced this code
- `state` (String) draft, tested_passed, tested_failed, live, previous, or discarded
- `test_outcome` (String) Latest test outcome: passed or failed
- `test_run_id` (String) Latest validation run for this revision
